entities.summary: Allen Wade Barbre is an American former professional football player who was an offensive guard in the National Football League (NFL). He was selected by the Green Bay Packers in the fourth round of the 2007 NFL draft. He played college football for the Missouri Southern Lions. He was also a member of the Seattle Seahawks, Miami Dolphins, Philadelphia Eagles, and Denver Broncos.
